commits.messageBody:
Use the bundled Miles SDK's UINTa for file callback handles, their maps and
the handle counter. Keep U32 byte counts and S32 seek offsets unchanged.
Format the debug handle through uintptr_t instead of narrowing it.

Native v120 compiles the actual Audio translation unit in Win32/x64 Debug
and Release and directly assigns all four SDK callback types without casts.
Hashed callback slices using real TreeFile/core libraries pass 18/18 checks
in Release and 20/20 in Debug on each ABI. x64 tests distinguish handles
7 and 0x100000007, check seek/read/close behavior and full-width failures.
Debug x64 requires the preceding allocator minimum-block repair.

This corrects the callback ABI; it supplies no x64 Miles implementation
and makes no audio playback, threading or complete-client fidelity claim.
